notice: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE DATA. These are generic investment types with round-number assumptions written for this educational tool. They are not live or current market data, do not describe any specific product, and are not forecasts. Real products of the same type can differ materially.

investments.name: High-interest savings account
investments.description: Insured deposit account with daily access. Value does not fluctuate, but returns may not keep pace with inflation.
notes: Deposit insurance has limits and rules that vary by country and institution.
Inflation can erode purchasing power over long horizons.

investments.name: 1-year term deposit (non-redeemable)
investments.description: Fixed-rate deposit locked until maturity, similar to a non-redeemable GIC or CD.
notes: Money is usually inaccessible until maturity.

investments.name: Short-term government bond fund
investments.description: Diversified fund of government bonds maturing within a few years.
notes: Prices fall when interest rates rise, although less than for longer-term bonds.

investments.name: Investment-grade corporate bond fund
investments.description: Diversified fund of higher-quality corporate bonds of mixed maturities.
notes: Exposed to interest-rate and credit-spread risk.

investments.name: Balanced fund (about 60% stocks / 40% bonds)
investments.description: Diversified mix of global stocks and bonds, rebalanced periodically.

investments.name: Global equity index fund
investments.description: Broadly diversified fund tracking stocks across many countries and sectors.
notes: Recovery from severe declines has historically taken years in some episodes.

investments.name: Dividend equity fund
investments.description: Diversified fund of stocks selected for dividend payments.
notes: Dividends can be cut, and the fund's value can fall like other equities.

investments.name: Covered-call equity fund
investments.description: Holds stocks and sells call options on them to generate extra cash distributions.
notes: Upside in strong markets is capped by the options sold, while most of the downside remains.
High distributions can include a return of capital.

investments.name: Listed real estate (REIT) fund
investments.description: Diversified fund of publicly traded real estate companies.
notes: Sensitive to interest rates and property-market cycles.

investments.name: Private real estate fund (with lock-up)
investments.description: Non-traded fund owning properties directly, with limited and gated redemptions.
notes: Appraisal-based valuations can make reported volatility look lower than the underlying risk.
Redemptions may be limited or suspended during stress.

investments.name: Single large-company stock
notes: Company-specific events can cause large, permanent losses that diversification would have softened.

investments.name: Major cryptocurrency
investments.description: A large, widely traded cryptocurrency held directly or through a fund.
notes: Extreme price swings; custody, platform and regulatory risks apply.
No cash flows to anchor valuation.

investments.name: 3x leveraged equity ETF (daily reset)
investments.description: Aims to deliver three times an index's daily return; designed for short-term trading.
notes: Daily rebalancing means returns over longer periods can differ sharply from 3x the index, especially in volatile markets.
